question: Should Reef core permanently own and support the Kubernetes/PostgreSQL relay and its operational compatibility contract alongside the Cloudflare relay?
rationale: The patch is not merely a deployment artifact: it adds a second persisted relay backend, upgrade path, and operational support surface that source review cannot authorize without product ownership.

options.title: Keep Cloudflare-only core scope
options.body: Do not merge the Node/PostgreSQL adapter into Reef core unless a narrower supported extension boundary is defined.

options.title: Adopt the Kubernetes relay
options.body: Sponsor the PostgreSQL and Helm adapter as a supported core platform, with explicit ownership for its compatibility and security contract.

options.title: Defer the boundary decision
options.body: Leave this PR open only while a maintainer evaluates the intended platform scope and support commitment.

recommendation.title: Keep Cloudflare-only core scope
recommendation.body: Do not merge the Node/PostgreSQL adapter into Reef core unless a narrower supported extension boundary is defined.

likelyOwner.reason: The design material ties Peter to the agreed Reef product design, which is the relevant ownership signal for this platform-boundary choice.
